title: Russian officials studying UFOs

tellings.quote: And there have been other Russian officials that come out and say, "Yeah, we we've got people studying the UFO questions."

plain: Russian officials have said publicly that their country has people studying UFOs. Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer, passes this on, quoting them as saying, "Yeah, we we've got people studying the UFO questions." If true, it would mean the interest in UFOs is not just an American one.
